ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

2. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.

3. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

6. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

7. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.

8. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.

9. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

11. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

12. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
